about.title: About the data

territorio.title: Territory
territorio.text: Area within the Caatinga boundary, according to IBGE (2019).

estoque.title: Stock
estoque.text: Fourth National Inventory, in 100 m squares. Carbon the original vegetation would store, without discounting current land use; includes soil carbon.
estoque.coverage: The inventory covers {pct} of this area; the total holds only for that part.

fluxo.title: Flux
fluxo.text: Global Forest Watch, version 1.4.2, 30 m; net balance from {first} to {last}. Areas with trees: canopy covering more than 30% of the ground in 2000, or canopy gain from 2000 to 2020.

uso.title: Land use
uso.text: MapBiomas, collection 10.1, 30 m, {first} and {last}. Native vegetation: forest, savanna and grassland formations, mangrove, flooded forest, restinga, flooded grassland and apicum. Agriculture and livestock includes mixed cropland and pasture areas.

degradacao.title: Degradation
degradacao.text: OCA index v4, from {year}, 500 m, in five levels; 5 is the most severe. "No data" is the part the index does not cover

chuva.title: Rainfall
chuva.text: CHIRPS, 5.6 km, from {first} to {last}. Dry or wet year: 10% or more below or above the territory's own mean; in between, normal.

units.title: Units
units.text: t C is a tonne of carbon; 1 t C equals 3.67 t of CO₂. CO₂e adds other greenhouse gases, such as methane and nitrous oxide, to CO₂.

comparison.title: Comparison with the Caatinga
comparison.text: Same sources and same calculation; for the biome, flux and land use at 100 m. Close: difference under 10%.

about.point: Here, value of a single point of the territory.
